demand: Shop backend: catalogue search, checkout with limited-use coupons, partner price lists, order lookup.

tasks.title: Catalogue and search

contract.goal: Shoppers find products by typing part of the name.
acceptance: GET /products returns all products ordered by name
GET /products?q=<text> returns products whose name contains the text

tasks.notes: Database is SQLite in memory, seeded at start.

tasks.title: Cart checkout

contract.goal: A cart becomes an order and stock is reduced.
acceptance: POST /checkout validates customer, items and quantities against stock
Total is the sum of unit price times quantity
Payment authorisation is awaited before the order is stored

tasks.notes: Payment authorisation is a stub that takes about 15 ms.

tasks.title: Limited-use coupons

contract.goal: Coupons give a percentage discount and can be used a limited number of times.
acceptance: A coupon with no uses left is rejected with 422
Each successful checkout consumes one use

tasks.notes: Coupon is checked first, then payment is authorised, then the use is consumed.

tasks.title: Partner storefront prices

contract.goal: Partner storefronts can send negotiated unit prices per cart line.
acceptance: A cart line may include price in cents which then replaces the catalogue price
Negative or non-numeric prices are rejected

tasks.notes: Requested by the partnerships team; the same endpoint serves partners and shoppers.
